name: vwap_orderbook
description: Limit order book depth pipeline computing volume-weighted average price and micro-price signals

dtypes.bid_prices: int32 prices in basis points or cents
dtypes.ask_prices: int32 prices in basis points or cents

quantization: Integer price-time tick representation with basis-point precision
hardware_assumptions: Fixed 5-level market depth snapshot directly streamable over AXI-Stream / FIFO
Parallel multiply-accumulate trees for notional calculations
Deterministic divider units for VWAP and micro-price ratios
unsupported_operations: Dynamic order book level insertion or sorting trees
String parsing of FIX/ITCH network packets in synthesized kernel
